reason: All five mandatory audit matrix items (MATRIX-001 through MATRIX-005) have been fully executed by their assigned agents. All available domain agents (Hardware, Risk Traceability, Software, DMR/SOP, Regulatory, V&V) have completed at least one domain_review run and at least one context_recheck run. Thirteen agent runs have been completed across seven agents. All major candidate areas identified in RUN-0001 have been investigated, cross-checked, and escalated where unresolved. No new candidate discovery is warranted; the corpus has been exhaustively interrogated within the supplied evidence catalog. The accumulated findings across all runs are sufficient for a human auditor to assess DHF/DMR consistency. Further agent cycling would not produce new evidence from the supplied corpus and would risk circular re-confirmation of already-documented gaps.

stop_conditions_checked.condition: All candidate areas from RUN-0001 investigated

human_review_items.description: PT9L is documented as having Bluetooth capability in the project profile and Risk Management Report, but no Bluetooth/BLE/wireless/RF hazard identification, risk control, or verification closure exists in any supplied document. This is a confirmed open gap requiring human auditor determination of whether a Bluetooth-specific risk assessment and verification record must be added to the DHF before design transfer or regulatory submission.

human_review_items.topic: Dual IFT/PT9L document-number prefix system on active risk management documents with no reconciling master document list
human_review_items.description: At least four active PT9L risk management documents (F0017–F0020) carry IFT-prefixed document numbers while four parallel documents (F0021–F0024) carry PT9L-prefixed numbers. No master document list, index, or change record reconciling the two prefix systems is present in the supplied evidence. Human auditor must determine whether one set supersedes the other and whether a formal document-number correction or change order is required.

human_review_items.topic: Blank approval fields across all risk management documents
human_review_items.description: All approval/review/submission date fields across every risk management document in the supplied evidence are blank. No signed approval records are present. Human auditor must determine whether signed originals exist outside the supplied corpus or whether formal approval of the risk management file is genuinely incomplete.

human_review_items.topic: Risk Management Report version mismatch in verification closure (V1.0 cited vs. V2.0 active) and unacknowledged revised test report
human_review_items.description: The design verification plan/report cites PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0 while the active risk report is V2.0. A revised ISO 80601-2-56 test report (ETX202303-07-078-03R1, dated 2025-05-29) exists in the corpus with no corresponding update to the design verification report. Human auditor must determine whether the verification closure loop is complete and whether a verification plan/report amendment is required.

human_review_items.topic: BOM spring-component conflict (PT3-P10 vs. PT5-M02+M03) and T-Z1-P10 dual-PCB part-number anomaly
human_review_items.description: Two BOM documents specify different spring components (single dual-spring PT3-P10 vs. separate PT5-M02 and PT5-M03), and the total-assembly drawing uses part number T-Z1-P10 for two distinct PCBs. Human auditor must determine which BOM is controlling, whether an ECO resolves the conflict, and whether the drawing part-number collision requires a drawing revision.

human_review_items.topic: BP3L software diagrams in PT9L software design folder without shared-component rationale; software version identifier mismatch (E0 23.11 vs. V1.0)
human_review_items.description: BP3L software architecture diagrams appear in the primary PT9L software design folder and T1 sample subfolder with no documented shared-component or reuse rationale. The software design document carries version identifier 'E0 23.11' which cannot be reconciled with 'V1.0' cited in test/validation records and BOM. Human auditor must determine whether a shared-component justification document is required and whether a version-identifier correction is needed.

human_review_items.topic: IEC 60601-1 test report references software design document PT9L-RJFA01 V1.0 absent from evidence catalog and design output index
human_review_items.description: The IEC 60601-1 test report cites software design document DN:PT9L-RJFA01 V1.0, which does not appear in the supplied evidence catalog or design output index. Human auditor must determine whether this document exists, whether it is the same as the document carrying 'E0 23.11', and whether the design output index requires updating.

human_review_items.topic: Design output list blank approval dates and absence of design transfer record
human_review_items.description: The design output list carries blank submission/review/approval date fields. No design transfer record or ECO/approval routing record is present in the supplied evidence catalog. Human auditor must determine whether formal design transfer has been completed and whether the design output list approval is genuinely outstanding.

human_review_items.topic: Document-number collision on drawing PT9L-F01 and part-number mismatch between packaging BOM files
human_review_items.description: Drawing PT9L-F01 is used for two distinct items in the design output chain. Two packaging BOM files specify different part numbers for what appears to be the same packaging component. Human auditor must determine which document/part number is controlling and whether a drawing or BOM correction is required.

human_review_items.topic: Biocompatibility reports conducted on PT5 samples rather than PT9L; operation guide references MDD rather than MDR
human_review_items.description: Biocompatibility reports in the supplied evidence were conducted on PT5 samples. No PT9L-specific biocompatibility report is present. The operation guide references MDD rather than MDR for biocompatibility compliance. Human auditor must determine whether PT5 biocompatibility data is acceptable for PT9L under ISO 10993-1 equivalence rationale and whether the operation guide requires correction.

human_review_items.topic: Dual ASTM E1965 version citation (1998:2016 and 1998:2023) without documented transition rationale; inconsistent EN ISO 80601-2-56 and MDR 2017/745 applicability between design input stages
human_review_items.description: Both the 2016 and 2023 editions of ASTM E1965-98 are cited in active documents without a documented rationale for the dual citation or a transition plan. EN ISO 80601-2-56 and MDR 2017/745 applicability differs between draft and final design input documents. Human auditor must determine which standards versions are controlling and whether a standards applicability matrix or change record is required.

human_review_items.topic: Absent 510(k) responsibility agreement for 'andon' as responsible and paying party
human_review_items.description: The project profile states that 'andon' is responsible and paying for 510(k) registration, but no 510(k) responsibility agreement, contract, or authorization letter is present in the supplied evidence. Human auditor must determine whether this agreement exists outside the supplied corpus and whether it must be included in the DHF.

human_review_items.topic: Object-temperature accuracy tolerance (±0.2 °C) applied at 30 °C and 45 °C in software test plans outside design-input specified range (≥35 °C to ≤42 °C)
human_review_items.description: Software test plans and the design verification plan apply the ±0.2 °C object-temperature accuracy tolerance at 30 °C and 45 °C, which are outside the design-input specified range of ≥35 °C to ≤42 °C. No documented justification for extending the tolerance to these temperatures is present. Human auditor must determine whether this represents a test plan error, a design-input gap, or an intentional extension requiring documented rationale.

human_review_items.topic: F0013 (PT2L risk plan in historical folder) internally carries a PT9L-series document number
human_review_items.description: F0013 is titled as a PT2L risk plan and filed in the '2L风险改 - 历史文件' historical folder, but its internal document number is a PT9L-series identifier. Human auditor must determine whether this document has been incorrectly numbered, whether it has any active status in the PT9L DHF, and whether a document-control correction is required.
